settings.text: Two easy ways to find your US ring size at home in under five minutes.

settings.title: Method 1: measure a ring you own
settings.text: Pick a ring that fits the intended finger comfortably. Measure the inside diameter edge to edge in millimeters, then match it to the chart.

settings.title: Method 2: measure your finger
settings.text: Wrap a thin strip of paper around the base of your finger. Mark where it overlaps, then measure the length in millimeters. That is your finger circumference; match it to the chart.

settings.title: US ring size chart
settings.text:
US 6: 16.5 mm diameter / 51.9 mm circumference
US 7: 17.3 mm / 54.4 mm
US 8: 18.1 mm / 57.0 mm
US 9: 19.0 mm / 59.5 mm
US 10: 19.8 mm / 62.1 mm
Available sizes are shown on each product page.

settings.title: Fit tips
settings.text: Measure at the end of the day, when fingers are slightly larger. Wide bands (over 4 mm) fit snugger, so consider the next size up. If you are between sizes, choose the larger one.
Email us at animajewels@animajewel.in before ordering. And if the size isn’t right, exchanges are free within 30 days.
